summary: Retest of in-app fullscreen map control on /karte (MapCanvas.tsx) per updated briefing, which removed the out-of-scope auth-gated /beitrag card-variant lane from this run. Backend suite (49 tests) passed, frontend typecheck passed, and all 6 browser checks for the 6 in-scope acceptance criteria re-ran clean (by name, no script changes) including the public preview ingress smoke. No regressions found.

checks.criterion: Fullscreen control opens the map in an in-app fullscreen view
checks.name: map-fullscreen-opens-inapp-layer
checks.evidence: At 390x844 on /karte, map-fullscreen-button aria-pressed toggled false->true on click; map-floating gained fixed/inset-0/z-50 classes; route stayed /karte (no navigation).

checks.criterion: Fullscreen map shows map content and controls
checks.name: map-fullscreen-shows-content-and-controls
checks.evidence: After opening fullscreen: map-image, map-layers-button, map-zoom-in-button, map-zoom-out-button all visible; no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth <= clientWidth).

checks.name: map-fullscreen-closes-cleanly
checks.evidence: Opened fullscreen (body.style.overflow='hidden'), toggled again: aria-pressed='false', map-floating lost fixed/z-50 classes, body overflow restored, route remained /karte.

checks.criterion: Zoom/pan and map data are not changed
checks.name: map-fullscreen-zoom-pins-unchanged
checks.evidence: Inside fullscreen, map-zoom-in-button changed --pin-scale CSS var; seeded pins remained visible after zoom.

checks.name: map-fullscreen-mobile-safe-viewport
checks.evidence: At 390x844, fullscreen button bounding box >= 44x44px and within viewport bounds; no horizontal scroll; zero >=400 HTTP responses and zero non-favicon console errors.

checks.name: core-routes-no-regression-390
checks.evidence: Guest flow /, /karte, /entdecken loaded at 390x844 with zero >=400 responses and zero non-favicon console errors. Also: `yarn typecheck` -> tsc --noEmit exit 0; backend pytest -> 49 passed, 0 failed.

checks.name: public-preview-map-fullscreen
checks.evidence: Ran against https://leonida-karte--6tt5kohx.preview.emergentagent.com: guest->/karte, fullscreen toggled aria-pressed true/false, map-floating gained/lost fixed class, zero >=400 responses.
